summary:
执行 I8 AlembicPlugin public-serving compatibility combined package。基线必须为干净的 AlembicPlugin@aba8c511be2a0de812fb8e9976062090fe49998d/tree 692dfa44f2b9b8cead5adde2755cc6396b75a643，并精确加载已接受 AlembicCore@5ad2e0a04d27000a27927acc4de0d83418b2420a 与 Alembic@bee8272f9ef2f959829577d38f27447a492e75e7 的 serving contracts/artifacts；不得猜字段或复制合同。

完成条件：1) Plugin 继续唯一拥有正式 Search、Graph、Recipe Map、Prime、Guard handlers/schemas；以 versioned serving fixtures 贯通普通 public resolver，验证 schema、handler、route 和 vector compatibility。2) route 指向已发布 snapshot 时，四个知识工具只读 CAS 后 pointed snapshot；Recipe Map 读取 exact FinalCoverageBindingReceipt，并把账目守恒与项目/知识覆盖结论分开；vector 只使用 pointed generation。3) Graph 始终 request-scoped live-source、Recipe-free，不读取候选或 pointed Recipe corpus；只允许携带 publication provenance，且 route-null 时仍正常工作。4) route-null/无 public pointer 时四个知识工具必须 typed unavailable/fail closed，不得回退旧库、候选库、默认路径或混合 session；Graph 不受该隔离影响。5) fixture 和负向回归必须覆盖 exact artifact/hash/version mismatch、stale route、route-null、跨 generation 混读、Map coverage binding 不匹配、vector mismatch，并经正式 handler 入口而非复制 handler 逻辑。

强禁止：不得访问 run-private candidate；不得新增 CandidatePublicationHandle、candidate reader/path override/cross-repo oracle transport；不得依赖或导入 Alembic Main，调用 producer/private runtime，或把 Plugin 五工具变成 pre-CAS gate；不得修改 Core/Main/Agent/Test/Wakeflow、vendor/gitlink/cache；不得运行真实项目冷启动或 T5/T6 正式矩阵。本包只关闭 I8 fixture-level public compatibility，真实 MR5/SP/Alembic/BiliDili 五工具矩阵仍由 CAS 后 T6 Test 完成。

验证与交付：先证明现有缺口/RED，再实现最小改动；运行 build/check、focused public resolver/handler/schema/route/vector tests、unit/integration、plugin distribution/runtime-package/smoke 边界门禁和 git diff --check。只提交一个干净 AlembicPlugin commit；回填 parent/commit/tree、changed files/symbols、exact loaded artifact hashes、RED/GREEN、原始命令摘要、两阶段自审、风险与剩余 Test 边界。完成后只返回总控评审，不自行启动 Test。
designIntent: Keep Plugin as the sole owner of formal Search/Graph/Recipe Map/Prime/Guard handlers and prove public-serving compatibility with exact accepted artifacts plus versioned fixtures, without introducing any producer-to-Plugin runtime gate.

targetTasks.summary: 完成 I8 公共 serving 兼容性：用 exact accepted artifacts 和 versioned fixtures 验证正式五个 MCP handler/schema/resolver；无 private candidate 访问，提交单一 Plugin commit 与可复验证据。
